test_title: PYST 73: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which day in February 2025 was celebrated as the National Science Day in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**28 February**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Science Day** is celebrated in India every year on **28 February** to commemorate the discovery of the **Raman Effect**.
 
• On this day in **1928**, the renowned Indian physicist **Sir Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman** (C.V. Raman) announced the discovery of the **scattering of light**, which was later named after him as the **Raman Effect**.
 
• For his revolutionary work in the field of **physics**, **Sir C.V. Raman** was honored with the **Nobel Prize in Physics** in **1930**. He was the first **Indian** and first **Asian** to receive a Nobel Prize in any branch of **science**.
 
• In **1986**, the **National Council for Science and Technology Communication (NCSTC)** requested the **Government of India** to designate **February 28** as National Science Day.
 
• The first National Science Day was celebrated on **February 28, 1987**, with the aim of spreading the message of the importance of **scientific applications** in the daily lives of the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sir C.V. Raman:**
 
 
• He was born on **7 November 1888** in **Tiruchirapalli**, **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• Apart from the Nobel Prize, he was also awarded India's highest civilian honor, the **Bharat Ratna**, in **1954**.
 
• He was also a recipient of the **Lenin Peace Prize** in **1957**.
 
 
 
• **The Raman Effect:**
 
 
• It is a phenomenon in **spectroscopy** where a **photon** of light interacts with a molecule, leading to a change in the **wavelength** and energy of the light.
 
• This discovery is widely used in **chemical laboratories** to identify the structure of molecules and in **medical diagnostics**.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of the Day:**
 
 
• To display all the activities, efforts, and achievements in the field of **science** for human welfare.
 
• To give an opportunity to the **scientific-minded** citizens in the **country** and encourage them to popularize **science and technology**.
 
• To foster a **scientific temper** among the youth of **India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Department of Science and Technology (DST)** acts as a nodal agency to support and coordinate the celebration of National Science Day throughout the **country**.
 
• The government announces a specific **theme** for National Science Day every year. For example, the theme for **2024** was "**Indigenous Technologies for Viksit Bharat**", focusing on homegrown **innovation**.
 
• Various awards, such as the **National Awards for Science Popularization**, are conferred on this day to individuals and **organizations** for their outstanding contribution to **science communication**.
 
• Developing a **scientific temper**, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform is a **Fundamental Duty** of Indian citizens under **Article 51A** of the **Constitution of India**.
